title: 21st Bucharest International Jazz Competition 2027
description: Compete live in Bucharest for €10,000 in jazz prizes. Open to jazz instrumentalists, bands, and vocalists up to age 45.
descriptionDetailed: The 21st Bucharest International Jazz Competition runs July 2-10, 2027 during EUROPAfest, offering €10,000 in cash and concert engagements. A jury of international jazz artists picks winners across band, vocalist, and jam session categories, with semifinalists and finalists performing live. Registration is €140 per band by March 1, 2027.

prize.description: Total prizes of €10,000 in cash and concert engagements: Grand Prize Winner €1,500, Best Band €500, Best Vocalist €500, Best Jam Session €250. Finalists also receive concert engagement opportunities.

audience.eligibilityLabel: Open to jazz musicians up to age 45
audience.eligibilityDetail: Open to instrumentalists, bands, and vocalists of all nationalities born after July 1, 1982. The band leader may be older than 45.
